name: apfel-research-led-identity
description: Build research-led visual identities: one researched fact grows a custom letterform, a dominant grid rule, and one controlled tension per piece.

interface.shortDescription: Research-led identities with a custom letterform and one grid rule
interface.longDescription: A six-step method distilled from how A Practice for Everyday Life works, not from how its projects look: research the object, pick one fact you can point at, draw a custom letterform and a dominant grid rule from it, keep one traceable tension per piece, and carry the system across poster, signage, web, and book. For cultural institutions, exhibitions, publishing, and craft brands.
defaultPrompt: Build a research-led identity for this exhibition.
Find one fact in this brand's craft and grow a logo and grid from it.
Design a poster, sign, website, and book cover from one researched seed.
